name: smwgraphics-super-princess-peach-tidal-wave
title: Super Princess Peach - Tidal Wave
description:
This sprite comes from World 5, Wavy Beach, but be careful, when using this sprite, it is recommended to edit the BG2 destination animations, as the 2 middle tiles are used to hold the player.

The sprite uses less of it's original frames for easier optimization.
